en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abi’l-Qasem, from Muhammed bin Ali al-Kufi, from Hasan bin Ali bin Yusuf, from Saif bin ‘Umayra, from Sa’eed bin Waleed, that he said: We entered with Aban bin Taghlib into the place of Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, and Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, said:
Verily, that I feed one Muslim till he is satisfied is more beloved to me than feeding a horizon of people. I said: How much is a horizon? He said: A hundred thousand.
